widgets_values: outfit_swap: use Picture 1 as the base image, preserving the original person’s identity, face, head, hairstyle, skin tone, body shape, pose, camera angle, framing, lighting, environment, and background. Replace only the clothing on the person in Picture 1 with the outfit from Picture 2. Strictly preserve the outfit from Picture 2, including its exact color, fabric material, texture, pattern, cut, silhouette, seams, collar, sleeves, waistline, accessories, and styling details. Do not change the face, hair, body proportions, pose, hands, legs, background, or lighting from Picture 1. Make the new outfit conform naturally to the body pose and perspective of Picture 1, with realistic folds, wrinkles, fabric tension, shadows, highlights, contact shadows, and occlusion. Seamless photorealistic integration, high quality, sharp details, 4k.

head_swap: start with Picture 1 as the base image, keeping its lighting, environment, and background. remove the head from Picture 1 completely and replace it with the head from Picture 2, strictly preserving the hair, eye color, nose structure of Picture 2. copy the direction of the eye, head rotation, micro expressions from Picture 1, high quality, sharp details, 4k
